scripts.build: pnpm --filter some-shade build && pnpm --filter playground build
scripts.publish:beta: pnpm build:component && pnpm --filter @johnfmorton/some-shade publish --tag beta --access public && pnpm tag && pnpm gh-release:beta
scripts.publish:release: pnpm build:component && pnpm --filter @johnfmorton/some-shade publish --access public && pnpm tag && pnpm gh-release
scripts.tag: V=v$(node -p "require('./packages/web-component/package.json').version") && git tag -m "$V" "$V" && git push origin "$V"
